summary.description: One or two sentences: the overall assessment.

title.description: At most 12 words naming the problem.

severity.description: Impact in play or on the project if real.

confidence.description: How sure you are that it is real.

file.description: Repository path of the file, exactly as given in the FILE headers.

symbol.description: The function, method or class (for example Cart.add_item).

evidence.description: One to three lines of code copied exactly, character for character, from that file, that show the problem. Never paraphrase or reconstruct code.

situation.description: The concrete inputs or state and what goes wrong.

test_file.description: Repository path of the existing test file where a test for this belongs (one of the FILE headers if shown; otherwise your best guess, for example tests/test_settings.py).

related.description: Other code a fix must read or change, as path:Symbol (for example src/menu.py:Menu.back). Empty if none.

checked_ok.description: Things you examined and found correct, one short line each.
